scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGKILL -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:debug: concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGKILL -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:debug --workspace=server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test:prod: npm run build --workspace=client && cd electron && npm run test:prod
scripts.build:dist:mac: npm run build --workspace=client && cd electron && npm install && npm run build:server && npm run build:mac
scripts.build:dist:win: npm run build --workspace=client && cd electron && npm install && npm run build:server && npm run build:win
scripts.build:dist:linux: npm run build --workspace=client && cd electron && npm install && npm run build:server && npm run build:linux
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:all: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
